mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_sy_chg_hist (trgt_tbl_nm, trgt_key, chg_type_cd, chg_item_nm, bfr_val, aft_val, chg_rsn, reg_user_id, reg_dttm) VALUES (#{tableName}, #{targetKey}, #{type}, #{item}, #{before}, #{after}, #{reason}, #{userId}, #{occurredAt})
mapper.select: SELECT trgt_tbl_nm AS "tableName", trgt_key AS "targetKey", chg_type_cd AS "type", chg_item_nm AS "item", bfr_val AS "before", aft_val AS "after", chg_rsn AS "reason", reg_user_id AS "userId", reg_dttm AS "occurredAt" FROM tb_sy_chg_hist WHERE trgt_tbl_nm = #{tableName} AND trgt_key = #{targetKey} AND chg_item_nm = #{item} AND chg_rsn = #{reason}AND chg_rsn IS NULL ORDER BY hist_id
